Sakura Bakushin O: the very incarnation of 
a class president. Fired up with passion 
to be a model student, she and her Trainer 
take on the Twinkle Series!

To serve as a guiding light for other 
students, she set a goal to "conquer all 
GⅠ races"... but competing in every single 
GⅠ is just not realistic.

Chided by Trainer, she set her sights for 
now on the royal road of Umamusume, 
including the Classics... and charged full 
steam ahead down the "Bakushin Road"!

Though she possesses true talent as a 
sprinter, her ambitions point in a bizarre 
direction, leaving her Trainer scratching 
their head over how to help her shine.
